name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 36 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 39 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 36 hours starting 2025-12-08, at wavelengths from 1.27 to 4.71 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
